verdict: International Paper sold $6.2B of packaging, flat versus a year ago — but a $1.38B non-cash write-down of its European business turned the quarter into a $1.1B loss from continuing operations.

segments.name: Packaging Solutions North America
segments.note: Boxes and containerboard across North America — sales were roughly flat, but profit more than doubled from Q2 to $427M on better prices and mill performance.

segments.name: Packaging Solutions EMEA
segments.note: The European packaging business being separated from the company — it lost $73M in the quarter in a soft market.

segments.name: Corporate & inter-segment
segments.note: Corporate items and sales between the company's own segments.

opex.name: Goodwill impairment
opex.note: A non-cash write-down of the value recorded for the European packaging business — the single biggest item in the quarter.

opex.name: Selling & administrative
opex.note: Selling and administration, including $65M of costs for separating the EMEA business.

opex.name: Distribution expenses
opex.note: Freight and delivery of paper and boxes to customers.

opex.name: Depreciation & amortization
opex.note: Spreading the cost of mills and machines over their lives, including $33M of accelerated depreciation from site closures.

opex.name: Restructuring, taxes & other, net
opex.note: Restructuring charges of $9M and $41M of non-income taxes, partly offset by a $23M net gain on asset sales.

otherDetail: Net interest expense of $96M, partly offset by $15M of non-operating pension income.

takeaways.title: North America is improving fast
takeaways.text: North America segment profit jumped to $427M from $204M in Q2 and a $166M loss a year ago, on price increases and better mill performance.

takeaways.title: Europe drove the headline loss
takeaways.text: The $1.38B goodwill impairment is non-cash — it writes down what the EMEA business is carried at ahead of its planned separation. Excluding special items, adjusted operating EPS was +$0.37.

takeaways.title: Cash profit held up
takeaways.text: Adjusted EBITDA from continuing operations was $843M, close to last year's $859M, even as GAAP results showed a $1.1B loss.

oneTimers: A $1.38B non-cash goodwill impairment on the Packaging Solutions EMEA business (before and after tax).
Special items overall added $2.70 per share of costs in the quarter, including EMEA separation costs and accelerated depreciation from site closures.
Discontinued operations — the former Global Cellulose Fibers business, sold in January 2026 — lost another $29M, taking the total net loss to $1,126M (EPS -$2.13).
footerNote: This page uses continuing operations, as International Paper presents them; discontinued operations are covered in the one-time items box. The tax line is a $97M benefit, which cushioned the loss.
